reasoning_traces.think:
The extraction architecture functions as a high-dimensional manifold traversal, decomposing complex document structures into discrete, verifiable operators. The core mathematical duality lies between the continuous nature of semantic meaning and the discrete, integer-based reality of record counting. By enforcing strict verbatim capture, the system establishes an injective mapping from source text to database entries, minimizing information entropy. The multi-lane approach introduces a parallelizable tensor network, where each lane (P2 through R5) operates as an independent stochastic process converging toward a global maximum likelihood estimate of total recall. The 'cap-free' pass specifically addresses boundary truncation errors, effectively extending the integration limits of the extraction integral. When a lane completes, the mechanical fold acts as a projection operator, collapsing the local lane state into the global master vector. This projection is guarded by a count-verification invariant, functioning similarly to a parity check in error-correcting codes. If the verification fails, the system enters a singular state, rejecting the update to preserve master integrity. The transition from vigilance-based completion to mechanical scripts represents a shift from heuristic control theory to rigid, deterministic automata. This ensures that the final delivery is not merely an approximation but a rigorously bounded solution to the extraction problem, accounting for situational rules and executable shares as distinct sub-manifolds within the broader knowledge graph.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This methodology inherits deeply from early 20th-century bibliometrics and mid-century automated theorem proving. It echoes the rigorous indexing principles of Vannevar Bush’s Memex, evolving through the structured data pipelines of the Semantic Web. The explicit focus on verbatim spans and provenance mirrors the foundational axioms of digital library science, while the mechanical, script-driven completion reflects the modern DevOps paradigm applied to epistemic accumulation.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The system implicitly models the author or source document as an agent attempting to convey precise mathematical or situational truths. Conversely, it treats the extraction pipeline itself as an adversarial actor prone to truncation and parsing failures. By anticipating these failure modes—such as front-loaded cap truncation—the pipeline pre-empts the 'deception' of incomplete data. It assumes the user requires absolute fidelity, necessitating a defensive architecture that verifies every incoming datum against strict invariants before accepting it into the trusted master state.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A critical veto condition exists between the raw OCR layer (P1) and the higher-level semantic reassembly layers (R2, R4). If the underlying OCR starves for CPU resources, producing garbled or incomplete spans, the downstream layers must veto any attempt to parse these corrupted inputs as valid equations. Furthermore, anti-collinearity checks ensure that identical formulas from different sources are not prematurely deduplicated, preserving the distinct provenance vectors. Leakage is prevented by strictly isolating situational records from executable equation records, ensuring that statistical fragments do not pollute the deterministic evaluation engine.
